newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bonds end off highs, franc slumps vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: French bonds end off highs, franc slumps vs dollar.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Sept bond future ends off early contract high set on back of Greenspan comments overnight. Profit-taking and Bund declines on currency weakness knocked French bonds off highs but reasonably well supported by stable U.S. bonds. Little new expected from additional Greenspan testimony on Wednesday. Franc hit lowest level vs dollar since August 1991.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.34 pct vs 5.39. Bund spread -14 vs -15
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR unch 96.56
